run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config and selected stages
load_config: load and validate a FastCSP workflow configuration from a YAML file for requested stages
detect_restart: detect if a FastCSP workflow is restarting by checking for an existing log file
generate_crystal_structures: generate putative crystal structures using Genarris as the first stage of the workflow
relax_and_filter_structures: relax deduplicated structures with ML and filter by energy and density cutoffs
